correctness.rationale: Use the two intersecting ellipses from Asahara et al. in rotated (u,w) coordinates; their first-quadrant intersection at (√2 a,√2 b) splits boundary into two arcs. Integrating the elliptic semicircle profiles gives 2[s arcsin(s)√(1−t²)−t arcsin(t)√(1−s²)], s=a+b,t=a−b, and limit at s=1 is single ellipse area π√(1−t²). Exact negative derivative in r=|t| proves unique balanced fixed-speed maximizer 2s arcsin s; inequalities 1−√(1−r²)>=r²/2 and r arcsin r>=r² prove globally sharp quadratic coefficient s arcsin s+2√(1−s²); endpoint expansion gives π−maxArea ∼ 2√(2(1−s)). Independent numerical integration of ellipse intersection at five parameter pairs corroborated formula and stability, not proof.
